name: Grimes Engravers Ltd
leadTime: 10–14 working days from approval of your proof
minimumOrder: Glass awards: 10 items or more. Bench plaques: no minimum.
summary: Family-run engravers in Cardiff, Wales, established in 1947 and now in its third generation. Supplies and produces engraved glass and crystal awards for companies and organisations, with a minimum order of 10 items. Also engraves memorial bench plaques in brass and stainless steel, with no minimum. Contact by email only; no visits or collections, and every order is delivered. Does not supply trophies or medals, or engrave personal items.
